transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. ____. What brings you in today?

Um, hi. I'm just... I guess I've been having some trouble lately. Just forgetting little things, mostly. Like, I'll forget to return a phone call, or I won't remember to turn in a form for something. Sometimes I'll forget to stop and run an errand on my way home from work. It's just... it's been happening enough that I thought I should probably talk to someone.
Did these memory problems start after a head injury or concussion?
Um, no. I don't think so. I haven't had a concussion or... hit my head or anything like that.
Were you having similar problems with attention or forgetfulness when you were a child?

Um... yeah, I suppose so. Even back in elementary school, I guess I was sort of... the kid who forgot permission slips and things. I'd lose my homework in my backpack a lot. My mom or my teachers usually had to remind me step by step to actually finish projects. So... yeah.
Did these attention and forgetfulness problems cause trouble in more than one area of your life when you were growing up?
Um... I'm not really sure. Mostly it was just school, I think. I don't really remember it being a big deal anywhere else... just, you know, normal kid stuff.
Were these attention and forgetfulness problems also happening at home or in other settings when you were a child, or mainly at school?

Um... mainly just school, I think. I mean, my mom had to remind me to do chores and stuff at home, but... that's just being a kid, right? I don't really remember it being a huge problem outside of school stuff.
When you were a child, did these problems also happen at home, not just at school?
Um... no, not really. Like I just said, it was mostly school. I don't really remember it being an issue at home.
Have you been feeling down or depressed most days lately?
No, not really. I feel fine in that way.
Do you still have these attention or forgetfulness problems now?
Um... yeah. I do. It's just... it's been noticeably harder to manage things lately. Mostly since I started an evening certificate program... I guess that was about 15 months ago.
Have you noticed any clear change in your memory or concentration compared with how you used to be before the last year or so?

Um... no, not really. I don't think my memory actually changed or anything. It's just... like I said, I just have more to keep track of now with the classes. But I'm pretty much the same as I always was.
Before age 12, do you remember having these same attention or forgetfulness problems?

Yeah... I guess so. Um, even back in elementary school, I was always the kid forgetting permission slips, or... losing my homework in my backpack. I usually needed my mom or the teacher to remind me, like, step by step just to finish projects. So, yeah.
